subject: FinPath discovery follow-up / schedule demo & loop in security/procurement
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Thompson <jordan.thompson@finpath.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FinPath discovery follow-up / schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap from our side:
- Primary use case: embed LLM-powered summarization and search across transaction documents.
- Scale: ~200k monthly queries, peak during EOD batch windows.
- Key constraints: PCI/PII controls, audit logging, and a requirement for predictable latency on 99th pct.

Next steps I propose:
1) 60-min technical demo + deep dive with your platform and security teams (we’ll show end-to-end request flow, KV caching, and quantization options).
2) Share SOC2 report and a short one-pager on deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

Are any of these slots workable for your team next week?
- Tue 10 Mar, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed 11 Mar, 13:00–14:00 PT
- Thu 12 Mar, 09:00–10:00 PT

I’m looping in Lauren (cc) to coordinate calendar invites. If you prefer, share a couple times and I’ll send calendar invites. Also, feel free to loop in procurement/security — I can bring Rishi (security) and Vivek (platform) from our side.

Attaching a short quickstart and our SOC2 attestation for your review.

Attachments: finpath-quickstart.pdf, SOC2-Attestation-Redwood-2025.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the recap.

Wed 11 Mar 13:00–14:00 PT works for us. I’ll invite Emily (procurement) and Sam (our infra lead) to the meeting — looping them on this thread so they have the context.

Couple quick clarifications before the demo:
- Do you have an expected throughput target we should validate against during the demo? (We can share representative traffic patterns.)
- Any non-negotiable compliance items we should surface to procurement ahead of time?

Thanks,

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Jordan. I’ve penciled Wed 11 Mar 13:00–14:00 PT and will send a calendar invite once times are confirmed on everyone's end.

Quick answers:
- Expected throughput: for the demo we’ll validate up to 500 req/s sustained for short bursts and show how batching/prefix caching reduces unit cost for heavy patterns. If you can share a sample trace or QPS distribution beforehand, we’ll tailor the demo.
- Compliance: I’ve attached our SOC2 attestation and a one-pager. For procurement/proc compliance items we typically see: data residency requirements, encryption-at-rest/transport, audit log retention, and KMS integrations. Rishi (cc) can call out anything else specific.

Rishi & Vivek — looping you both in to align on the technical deep dive and the security checklist. Rishi, Jordan mentioned PCI/PII concerns; would you prefer we collect a questionnaire ahead of the call or cover the checklist live?

Calendar invite (tentative): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123
HubSpot record: HS-123456789

Subject: Re: FinPath discovery follow-up / schedule demo & loop in security/procurement

Hi Jordan — thanks for the context and for looping us in. A few quick notes from security:

1) Questionnaire vs live: If procurement wants an initial pass, Emily can send our standard security questionnaire and we’ll complete the relevant sections. Otherwise we can walk through the checklist live during the demo.
2) Items we’ll want to confirm early:
   - Data residency options (regions supported, retention controls)
   - Encryption and KMS integration (customer-managed keys available on Private/Dedicated)
   - Audit logging (user-level request logs, retention windows)
   - KV cache behavior and whether any user PII is persisted in cache

I’m attaching the SOC2 attestation we shared earlier and a brief checklist for reference. Also linking our security FAQ: https://docs.redwood.com/security/faq

If Emily can share the procurement timeline (PO lead times / contract owner), that will help us prioritize any pre-demo work.

Thanks — Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
